name: Long Wave Broadcast
description: European LW band; 9 kHz spacing. Largely shut down but still active in places.

name: Medium Wave Broadcast (R1)
description: European MW band; 9 kHz channel spacing, not the 10 kHz US raster.

name: FM Broadcast (CEPT)
description: European FM band starts at 87.5; the US band starts at 88.0. 100 kHz raster.

name: OIRT FM Band
description: Legacy Eastern European FM band; largely retired but still used in a few countries.

name: DAB Band III
description: European digital radio band; see dab.csv for the individual block raster.

name: DVB-T/T2 UHF
description: European digital television after the 700 MHz clearance; 8 MHz channels.

name: DRM Shortwave
description: Digital Radio Mondiale shares the international broadcasting bands.
